# Muhammad Bilawal — Full Stack Developer

> Full Stack Developer engineering with precision: backend systems, REST APIs, and full-stack products built with Laravel, Node.js, React, and Next.js — from database schema to production deployment. Based in Karachi, Pakistan (UTC+5), open to remote roles.

Muhammad Bilawal has 2+ years of production experience and has delivered 10+ projects, including an enterprise commerce system with 40+ modules built over 1.3 years. His most recent role was Full Stack Developer at THE HELPEX (2023 — 2026), after a frontend internship at SYBRID (2022 — 2023). He is currently pursuing a BS in Computer Science at the University of Karachi alongside a software engineering diploma at Aptech.
